correctness.rationale: The exact assembly EGF and mixed factorial-moment identity are proved and corroborated by a standalone finite exhaustive checker. Bassino--Nicaud--Weil provide a_n asymptotics and path-count concentration. Effective bounded-degree Hanf locality then shows a fixed FO sentence is asymptotically determined by finitely many capped independent Poisson short-component counts, proving effective rational-exponential limits. Cycle-existence sentences realize a dense set via harmonic partial sums. No finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the natural uniform partial-injection relational model, the theorem determines the asymptotic status of every fixed first-order property, constrains all limit values to an effective rational-exponential ring, and proves the exact set of attainable values is dense. This distinguishes a nontrivial convergence law from zero-one behavior and is more than a known coefficient table or numerical experiment.
